eps.d: It's Daphne's birthday, and Dirk has nothing to give her, but Singe engineers a plot where Dirk finds a statue of a giant golden bird to give as his gift. At Daphne's birthday party, the statue comes to life and carries her off to the Dragon's Lair.

Timothy's friend is thrown in prison for incompetence when a map he is guarding is stolen by the Lizard King. The Lizard King wants the map because it details the location of the secret royal gold mine. The Lizard King needs gold in order to perform his magic. Timothy sets off alone to recover the map and free his friend, but he is soon captured by the Lizards.

eps.t: The Tournament of the Phantom Knight
eps.d: There's a big tournament at King Ethelred's castle but an evil stranger interupts the proceedings.
Sir Dirk's & Princess Daphne's search for a new suit of armor for the king (and a guy who introduces himself as "Walker") leads them to an enchanted blacksmith's shop...and into a lot of trouble!

Spring has come to grace the land of Ethelred's Kingdom. From far and near the King's subjects gather together in celebration of the most wonderful season of all. However a wicked witch is turning everyone to stone.
An old magician (named Alfred) offers to make Daphne his apprentice and gives her a book of spells. The Princess bites off more than she can chew when she uses a spell to imprison Singe.
In the village square of Tregenna stands a magical golden wind chime. But someone evil wants the chimes to control the weather.
In a distant village called Crows Wood an evil sorceress from the past plans to seek revenge with her evil gaze.
Singe uses a magical mirror to transform himself into a Dirk doppelganger and terrorizes the countryside. Sir Dirk must stop Singe and clear his good name.
In a dark forest Dirk plans to explore some legendary hidden ruins, not realizing he would soon be embarking on a very strange and cold journey.

eps.t: The Tale of Dirk's New Sword
eps.d: On the isle of Narg, Lord Narg and his trolls plan to prepare war on the mainland by using magic wood to build an invincible war machine.

eps.t: The Legend of the Giant's Name
eps.d: In his latest plot against King Ethelred's kingdom, Singe awakens the last of the Ardu Giants by saying his real name.
Sir Dirk and Sir Blunt set out on a mission to get Singe's sword from the heart of the Dragon's Lair.
